headline.title: 3 days left to save up to $190 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 pass
headline.summary: Early Bird registration for the TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 ends in three days, allowing attendees to save up to $190 on their passes. The deadline for this discount is June 26 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

articles.title: Introducing computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash
articles.summary: Gemini 3.5 Flash introduces enhanced computer use capabilities, allowing users to leverage advanced features for improved productivity. This update aims to streamline workflows and integrate more seamlessly with various applications.

articles.title: The $27 million Al proxy war over Alex Bores ends in a draw
articles.summary: The $27 million political proxy war between Anthropic and OpenAI concluded with Alex Bores losing the Democratic primary for New York's 12th Congressional district. Bores, whose popularity increased due to targeting by a pro-AI super PAC, narrowly lost the election.

articles.title: Agility Robotics plans to go public via SPAC in a $2.5B deal
articles.summary: Agility Robotics, a humanoid robotics startup founded in 2015, plans to go public through a SPAC merger valued at $2.5 billion. The company anticipates raising $620 million from the transaction.

articles.title: I Met With China’s Top AI Experts. They’re Freaking Out, Too
articles.summary: Experts in China express concerns about the escalating AI arms race with the US, fearing potential catastrophic outcomes akin to a "Chernobyl moment." Researchers from both nations are increasingly anxious about the implications of rapid advancements in artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Figma adds code layers, support for animations, more AI features in new update
articles.summary: Figma has released an update that introduces a new code layer, enhanced support for animations and shaders, and the capability to create custom plugins utilizing AI. These features aim to improve design workflows and expand the platform's functionality.

articles.title: Qualcomm Buys Buzzy Chip Startup Modular for Nearly $4 Billion
articles.summary: Qualcomm has acquired chip software startup Modular for approximately $4 billion, marking a significant move in the AI chip sector. Modular is recognized as a leading player in the development of innovative chip software solutions.

articles.title: Accelerating Transformers Fine-Tuning with NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel
articles.summary: NVIDIA has introduced NeMo AutoModel, a tool designed to streamline and accelerate the fine-tuning process of transformer models. This innovation aims to enhance the efficiency of AI model training, making it more accessible for developers and researchers.

articles.title: OpenAI unveils its first custom chip, built by Broadcom
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced its first custom chip, named Jalapeño, which was developed in collaboration with Broadcom to meet the specific requirements of its inference systems. This new processor aims to enhance the performance and efficiency of OpenAI's AI models.

articles.title: OpenAI and Broadcom unveil LLM-optimized inference chip
articles.summary: OpenAI and Broadcom have launched Jalapeño, a custom AI chip designed specifically for optimizing large language model (LLM) inference. This new chip aims to enhance performance, efficiency, and scalability in AI systems.

articles.title: Congresswoman denies staff used AI to write defense funding amendment
articles.summary: Rep. Anna Paulina Luna (R-FL) clarified that her staff utilized AI only for spellcheck in an amendment summary for a defense funding bill, denying that AI was involved in drafting the bill text. This statement follows the circulation of screenshots on social media suggesting otherwise.

articles.title: OpenAI reveals its first AI processor: Jalapeño
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced its first AI processor, named Jalapeño, developed in collaboration with Broadcom. This application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) is designed to enhance the performance of current and future large language models by optimizing AI inference tasks.
